name: Watched file of accounts or access changed
description: The agent (1.32.0+) compares the SHA-256 of /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/group, /etc/sudoers, /etc/ssh/sshd_config and root's authorized_keys with the previous collection and sends a record when one changed. A change made with the tools of the system (useradd, passwd, visudo) shows too: what matters is a change nobody expected.
